name: Atheists
overview: Scripture reveals that faith in Christ is essential and often absent in the world, as Jesus questioned whether He would find faith upon His return (Luke 18:8). The world, unable to perceive the Spirit of truth, does not know Him, but believers do because He dwells within them (John 14:17). Despite human resistance or ignorance, God remains merciful and gracious, abundant in mercy (Psalms 103:8). The example of Agrippa's near persuasion to Christianity (Acts 26:28) and the natural law written in the hearts of Gentiles (Romans 2:14) highlight God's desire for all to come to faith and acknowledge Him.
